space.description: The space; default: the workspace's default space

library.description: List patterns only from this library; omit to search every library in the space

facets.description: Filter by facet key to allowed values; a pattern matches when every requested key holds at least one requested value

contains.description: Only patterns whose id or summary holds this, ignoring ASCII case

after.description: The page starts after this pattern: the value of the last answer's next.after, written <library>/<pattern> when more than one library is listed

includeProposed.description: Include proposed patterns and copies for review; omitted or false serves only approved content
